offering_description.value: Designs and makes barcode printers, mobile computers, scanners, RFID and machine vision products, plus software and services, sold mainly to businesses through direct sales and channel partners for tracking assets, inventory and transactions.

primary_products.value: barcode printers; mobile computers; barcode scanners; RFID readers; machine vision cameras

primary_services.value: software subscriptions; device maintenance and support; managed services; asset intelligence services

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, manufacturers, logistics companies, hospitals, hospitality operators; B2G: government agencies using field and mobile devices

end_markets.value: retail; manufacturing; transportation and logistics; healthcare; hospitality; government

revenue_model.value: product sales: printers, mobile computers, scanners and machine vision hardware; subscription: software and device management subscriptions; service fees: device support, maintenance and managed services contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes hardware, sold to channel partners and end customers; brand owner: sells own-brand devices and software built with purchased components; software / platform: sells device software and asset tracking platforms to enterprise customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: sales and service across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: barcode printers, mobile computers, scanners, RFID and machine vision share customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: large enterprise and government accounts; distributors / dealers: value-added distributors supplying resellers; partners / resellers: systems integrators and value-added resellers; online: online store for certain devices and supplies
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only product certifications such as radio emissions and electrical safety standards
